entries.text: TPC-DS OBT queries load from a hand-owned static catalog (`benchbox/core/tpcds_obt/catalog/queries.yaml`) instead of being converted from the TPC-DS templates at startup. Rendered SQL is unchanged. Each entry records the source template's SHA-256, its dsqgen placeholders and its identifier map, and unit tests fail when a template, define or identifier choice drifts. `benchbox/core/tpcds_obt` no longer imports SQLGlot, and Doris and StarRocks OBT queries get derived-table aliases from the fork's `add_derived_table_aliases` rewrite through `translate_sql_query`.
